_note: Synthetic data for an educational SOC 2 readiness concept. Not a real assessment.

controls.title: Code of conduct acknowledged at hire and annually
controls.description: Every employee and contractor signs the code of conduct when they join and re-acknowledges it each year; HR tracks completion and escalates non-signers.

controls.title: Background checks completed before start date
controls.description: Criminal, employment, and (for finance and engineering roles) credit screening is completed and cleared before a new hire receives system access.

controls.title: Quarterly security steering committee with board reporting
controls.description: A cross-functional steering committee reviews the security program, open risks, and incidents each quarter, and reports to the board audit committee.

controls.title: Org chart and role descriptions define security responsibility
controls.description: Documented reporting lines and job descriptions state who owns which security and compliance responsibilities; reviewed when the org changes and at least annually.
controls.evidenceType: Approved org chart and job descriptions

controls.title: Annual security awareness training with completion tracking
controls.description: All staff complete role-appropriate security training each year, including secure coding for engineers and fraud awareness for finance. Completion is tracked and enforced.

controls.title: Performance reviews include control responsibilities
controls.description: Annual performance reviews assess whether individuals met the security and compliance responsibilities in their role. Currently applied to managers only, not all staff.

controls.title: Information security policy suite reviewed and approved annually
controls.description: A documented policy set (security, access, change, incident, vendor, data handling) is reviewed, approved by the CISO, and published to all staff each year.
controls.evidenceType: Approved policy set with version history

controls.title: Confidential reporting channel for security and ethics concerns
controls.description: Staff can report security, fraud, or ethics concerns through a named channel and an anonymous hotline; reports are logged and triaged by the CISO and General Counsel.

controls.title: System description and security commitments published to customers
controls.description: The trust page, MSA, and DPA describe the system boundary, security commitments, and customer responsibilities; reviewed annually and on material change.

controls.title: Data classification standard maintained and communicated
controls.description: A four-tier classification standard (public, internal, confidential, restricted/cardholder) defines handling rules. The standard exists but has not been rolled out to all data stores.

controls.title: Annual enterprise risk assessment with maintained risk register
controls.description: Management identifies and rates risks to security and processing objectives, assigns owners and treatment plans, and maintains the results in a risk register.

controls.title: Fraud risk assessment covering payment and payout flows
controls.description: A specific assessment of fraud scenarios — fictitious vendors, duplicate or self-approved payouts, insider misuse of production data — with mapped mitigating controls.

controls.title: Risk review of significant system and business changes
controls.description: Material changes (new payment rails, new subprocessors, re-architecture) get a documented risk review before launch. Applied inconsistently to infrastructure changes.

controls.title: Vendor risk assessment before onboarding
controls.description: New vendors with access to production or confidential data are risk-rated and reviewed (SOC 2 report, security questionnaire, contract terms) before contract signature.

controls.title: Quarterly internal control self-assessment
controls.description: Control owners attest each quarter that their control operated, and attach evidence. Compliance samples and challenges the attestations. Two of the last four quarters were skipped.

controls.title: Annual third-party penetration test with tracked remediation
controls.description: An external firm performs network and application penetration testing annually; findings are risk-rated, assigned, and tracked to closure against defined SLAs.
controls.evidenceType: Pen test report and remediation tracker

controls.title: Control deficiencies tracked to closure and reported to management
controls.description: Deficiencies from self-assessments, pen tests, and incidents are logged with owner, due date, and status, and reported monthly to leadership. Reporting has been ad hoc.

controls.title: Control matrix maps every control to criteria, owner, and frequency
controls.description: A maintained control matrix links each control to the criteria it addresses, names an accountable owner, and states test frequency; reviewed annually by Compliance.

controls.title: Segregation of duties matrix defined for payment and production roles
controls.description: A documented conflict matrix defines role pairs that must not be held by the same person across the payment, payroll, and production-change systems. Defined, but not enforced or monitored.

controls.title: Automated policy enforcement in CI/CD and cloud configuration
controls.description: Pipeline gates and cloud policy-as-code block known-bad configurations (public buckets, unencrypted volumes, missing tags) before they reach production.

controls.title: Unique user IDs with SSO and enforced MFA
controls.description: All corporate and production applications authenticate through the identity provider with unique accounts and mandatory multi-factor authentication; shared accounts are prohibited.
controls.evidenceType: IdP configuration export and MFA coverage report

controls.title: Access provisioning requires documented approval from the data owner
controls.description: New access is requested through a ticket and approved by the system or data owner before it is granted. Approvals are inconsistently captured for engineering tooling.

controls.title: Access revoked within 24 hours of termination
controls.description: Offboarding triggers removal of SSO, VPN, production, and financial system access within one business day, with a checklist signed by IT. Tickets for part of the period cannot be produced.

controls.title: Quarterly user access review of production and financial systems
controls.description: System owners review every account and privilege level each quarter and certify or revoke. The review has not been performed for the audit period.

controls.title: Privileged access restricted, time-bound, and reviewed
controls.description: Administrative and production write access should be granted just-in-time with expiry and approval. Today privileged roles are standing and unreviewed.
controls.evidenceType: JIT grant logs and privileged role inventory

controls.title: Production database access brokered through a logged bastion
controls.description: Direct database access requires going through a bastion host that records the session; direct network paths to production data stores are blocked.
controls.evidenceType: Bastion session logs and network policy

controls.title: Encryption in transit for all external connections
controls.description: TLS 1.2 or higher is enforced on every externally reachable endpoint, with weak ciphers disabled and certificates monitored for expiry.
controls.evidenceType: TLS scan results and load balancer config

controls.title: Encryption at rest for cardholder and merchant data stores
controls.description: Databases, object storage, backups, and snapshots holding cardholder or merchant data are encrypted at rest with managed keys and rotation enabled.

controls.title: Endpoint protection and full-disk encryption on company laptops
controls.description: Managed laptops enforce disk encryption, screen lock, patching, and EDR agent health; unmanaged devices cannot reach internal applications.

controls.title: Physical access to facilities and data centers restricted
controls.description: Office entry uses badge access with a reviewed badge list; data center physical security is carved out to AWS and covered by reviewing their SOC 2 report annually.
controls.evidenceType: Badge access list and subservice SOC 2 review

controls.title: Secure disposal of decommissioned media and devices
controls.description: Laptops and storage media are cryptographically erased or destroyed at end of life with a certificate of destruction retained. Process is informal for cloud volumes.

controls.title: Malicious software prevention on servers and workloads
controls.description: Container images are scanned and signed, only approved base images are allowed, and runtime agents alert on unexpected binaries in production workloads.
controls.evidenceType: Image scan results and admission policy

controls.title: Centralized logging with security alerting
controls.description: Application, infrastructure, and identity logs ship to a central store with alerting on privileged actions, failed authentication spikes, and configuration changes.
controls.evidenceType: SIEM alert rules and sample alerts

controls.title: Vulnerability scanning with severity-based patch SLAs
controls.description: Infrastructure and dependency scanning runs monthly with remediation SLAs by severity (critical 7 days, high 30). Scans run, but overdue criticals are not tracked to closure.
controls.evidenceType: Scan reports and SLA aging report

controls.title: Documented incident response plan with defined roles
controls.description: An IR plan defines severity levels, on-call roles, escalation paths, evidence handling, and customer and regulator notification timelines; reviewed annually.

controls.title: Annual incident response tabletop exercise
controls.description: A simulated incident is run each year with the response team, and gaps identified feed back into the plan. No exercise has been performed.

controls.title: Security events triaged, tracked, and communicated
controls.description: Alerts are triaged against defined severity criteria, incidents are logged with a timeline, and affected customers are notified per contractual commitments.

controls.title: Configuration baselines and drift detection for cloud infrastructure
controls.description: Hardened baselines are defined for compute, storage, and network resources, with automated drift detection. Detection covers production only, not the shared services account.

controls.title: Peer review and approval required before code merges to main
controls.description: Branch protection requires an approving review from someone other than the author before merge. Administrators can bypass the rule and several bypasses were used during the period.
controls.evidenceType: Pull request approval export and bypass log

controls.title: Automated test suite and CI gates pass before deployment
controls.description: Unit, integration, and contract tests plus security scanning must pass in the pipeline before an artifact is promoted to production.

controls.title: Separate development, staging, and production environments
controls.description: Environments are isolated by account and network, and production data is not copied into lower environments. Some legacy debugging exports to staging still occur.

controls.title: Emergency change procedure with retrospective approval
controls.description: Break-glass changes should be logged, justified, and approved after the fact within one business day. No formal procedure exists and emergency deploys are untracked.

controls.title: Infrastructure changes made through version-controlled IaC
controls.description: Cloud infrastructure changes go through Terraform with peer review and a plan-approval step; console changes are detected and reverted.
controls.evidenceType: Terraform PR history and drift reports

controls.title: Business continuity and disaster recovery plan tested annually
controls.description: A BC/DR plan defines RTO and RPO for payment processing and is validated by an annual restore and failover test. The plan exists; the test was not completed this period.

controls.title: Vendor contracts carry security terms and subservice reports reviewed
controls.description: Critical vendor contracts include security, confidentiality, and breach-notification terms, and their SOC 2 reports are reviewed annually with CUEC follow-up.
controls.evidenceType: Contract clause review and SOC 2 review memos

controls.title: Processing commitments and data quality definitions documented
controls.description: Published documentation states what NimbusPay commits to on payment completeness, accuracy, and timing, and defines the data quality rules merchants can rely on.

controls.title: Payment input validation and authorization at the API boundary
controls.description: Every payment instruction is schema-validated, authenticated to a merchant key, checked for required fields and limits, and rejected with a typed error when invalid.

controls.title: Idempotency keys prevent duplicate payment processing
controls.description: Payment requests carry an idempotency key enforced at the ledger layer so retries and network failures cannot create duplicate transfers.
controls.evidenceType: Idempotency design doc and duplicate-rate metrics

controls.title: Daily reconciliation of processed payments to settlement files
controls.description: An automated job reconciles the internal ledger to processor settlement files each day and routes breaks to an exception queue. The job runs, but sign-off evidence is missing for much of the period.

controls.title: Exception and error queue reviewed and cleared within SLA
controls.description: Failed or broken transactions land in an exception queue reviewed daily by Payment Operations, with aging thresholds and escalation. Aging items regularly exceed the SLA.

controls.title: Merchant output reporting reconciled before release
controls.description: Settlement statements and payout reports are reconciled to the ledger and reviewed before release to merchants, so merchants only receive complete and accurate figures.

controls.title: Confidential data inventory and retention schedule maintained
controls.description: An inventory records where confidential and cardholder data lives, its classification, owner, and retention period. The inventory is incomplete for analytics data stores.

controls.title: Confidential data deleted at the end of its retention period
controls.description: Automated deletion should remove confidential records once retention expires, with evidence of deletion retained. Deletion is manual, undocumented, and has not been run.

controls.title: Cardholder numbers tokenized and excluded from logs
controls.description: Primary account numbers are tokenized at ingress, stored only in the vault, and scrubbed from application logs, traces, and error reports by an automated filter.
controls.evidenceType: Tokenization architecture and log scan results

controls.title: Confidentiality agreements with employees and vendors
controls.description: Employees, contractors, and vendors with access to confidential data sign confidentiality agreements before access is granted, tracked by Legal.
